profile.name: Muhammad Fahmi Ady Susilo
profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.about: A Software Developer with experience in frontend development using ReactJS and Tailwind CSS, and an understanding of backend development with PHP, PostgreSQL and frameworks such as CodeIgniter and Laravel. Has contributed to education web projects such as academic information systems, admissions (PMB) and CBT, and to the SDMPKS palm-oil scholarship system of the Directorate General of Estate Crops, which digitises a national scholarship service.

highlights: Developed and maintained the registration platform for the SDM Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit scholarship (SDMPKS) of the Directorate General of Estate Crops in 2025, serving more than 20,000 applicants.

Developed and maintained the Patriot Connect research management platform of the Ministry of Transmigration for two consecutive periods (2025–2026); each year it is used by about 2,000 lecturers, alumni and students from leading Indonesian universities.

Developed the Patriot Connect scholarship management platform for the Ministry of Transmigration, designed for the 2026 programme with leading Indonesian universities; the ministry later cancelled the programme.
Developed supporting features for MauKuliah, an information platform for prospective students with more than 1,000 visitors a day.
Developed features of the Litabmas module (research and community service) for lecturers and students, implemented and piloted at about 200 client universities.
Developed features of the Kerja Sama module that university admins use to manage institutional partnerships, implemented and piloted at about 150 client universities.
Contributed to the revamp of the Tracer Study platform on the backend by building a REST API in Golang.
Built nine types of custom reports for partner universities and completed on average more than 50 tasks a month within the SLA.
Built a report builder with AI-assisted development, so university admins can create reports themselves and the internal team's workload went down.
Presented “Building and Managing Modern Websites: From Design to Deployment” and shared experience at a workshop organised by Himpunan Mahasiswa Informatika and Wargalab.
Developed an information system for finding tourism, culinary spots, lodging, transportation and local crafts in Madura.
Helped design the interface with React and Tailwind CSS, and worked with the backend team on consuming the API.
Assisted lecturers in practical lab sessions by delivering the learning modules to students.
Lecturer assistant for 2 semesters, across 4 lab classes of about 40 students each.
Courses: Introduction to Information Technology, Web Application Programming, Database I and Database II.

projects.title: Clipper Studio
projects.description: A Laravel app that turns long YouTube videos into vertical 9:16 clips: AI picks the best moments with a viral score, then FFmpeg cuts and renders them with word-by-word karaoke subtitles, face-following reframing (OpenCV), jump cuts and B-roll. Approved clips are published or scheduled to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels, Instagram Reels and Threads, with an Autopilot that watches YouTube channels, A/B hook tests, and a REST API and MCP server for AI agents.
projects.note: Screenshot of the public landing page (clipper.asfahmidev.com/welcome), captured 2026-11-16 without signing in. Repo checked public on 2026-11-16.

projects.title: Lega
projects.description: A macOS terminal app with Indonesian arrow-key menus that backs up iPhone photos and videos over USB to the laptop, then uploads them to Google Drive. It checks each file's MD5 against Drive and only deletes from the iPhone what is verified safe; everything runs on the Mac, with no server.
projects.note: Case image is a drawing of lega's terminal screen (scripts/case-images/lega-terminal.html): menu text copied from the source, progress figures illustrative. The repo (and so the install one-liner) answered 404 on 2026-11-16, i.e. private: set github to the repo URL once it is public and the panel shows the link and the install command.

projects.title: Batik Selling Price Prediction
projects.description: A website that predicts the selling price of Madura batik from four variables: cloth price, production time, motif difficulty and number of colours. It uses Fuzzy Mamdani, with the fuzzy rules optimised by a genetic algorithm to improve accuracy (undergraduate thesis).
